snippet.title: Whispering Eclipsia - Launch Early Alpha Footage
snippet.description:
Whispering Eclipsia is a gripping first-person psychological horror detective game built in Unreal Engine 5.

Step into the shoes of Inspector Keshav as he arrives at the rain-drenched, infamous Woodslane Bungalow to investigate a gruesome 16th ritualistic murder. As time fractures and dark reality bends, you must search for clues, make high-stakes dialogue choices, and confront an unseen entity lurking in the shadows.

Every clue brings you closer to the truth. Every answer pulls you deeper into the darkness.    

steam link -  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2826170/Whispering_Eclipsia/
